description: Barrages en Vendée is a dataset listed in Data.vendee.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by DREAL Pays de la Loire. Barrages contrôlés par le Service de Contrôle de la Sécurité des Ouvrages Hydrauliques de la DREAL Pays de la Loire. Coverage: Vendée. The portal files it under Territoires. Its keywords are Barrage, Eau, TEO. The portal shows 116 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-11-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-vendee-fr-portal.
